ablation.label: PRE-GATE / MODEL-OBSERVED / EXPLORATORY
ablation.note: each mechanism is switched off by removing the model TERM (fidelity switch), never by moving a registered parameter; interactions are second-order factorial residuals and are NOT causal claims

configuration.note: wall-clock timings are machine-specific (2 vCPU sandbox); the speedup ratio is the reproducible quantity, and the deviations are the physics check

benchmark.reference_note: reference = scalar bisection per bias point (V1.9-B, kept as the regression oracle)

convergence.note: the production settings (n_table 4001, 1200 curve points, 5 nm) are validated against the finest settings listed here

availability.interpretation: fraction of the silicon cell's radiative emission lying above the perovskite bandgap; the channel is activated by luminescent_coupling_bottom_to_top multiplied by this factor

coupling.conclusion: TOP-LIMITED DEVICE: adding current to the bottom cell (or re-absorbing its emission in the top cell) cannot relieve min(Jsc) when the top cell is the limiting one.
coupling.label: PRE-GATE / MODEL-OBSERVED / EXPLORATORY

extreme_thermal_resistance.expectation: the 454 K corner: reported, not clipped

ideal_rear_trapping.expectation: the full light-trapping limit must not exceed detailed balance

no_thermal_resistance.expectation: near-zero thermal resistance must approach the fixed-T efficiency

perfect_arc_rear.expectation: rear reflector + tuned ARC must increase bottom-cell Jsc

strong_parasitic.expectation: parasitic absorption must remove photons from the useful budget

thin_top_cell.expectation: a thin top cell trades top-cell current for bottom-cell current

tiny_shunt.expectation: a 50 ohm cm2 shunt must destroy FF

weak_top_absorption.expectation: the registered lower absorption limit must reduce the top-cell current

zero_recombination.expectation: switching the SRH/surface channel off (include_srh=False, the L1 ideal-single-diode limit) must raise Voc

metadata.topology: monolithic two-terminal tandem (current-matched), perovskite top / silicon bottom

physics_digest.algorithm: sha256 over canonical json of the artifact with the benchmark/metadata blocks and all timing-valued keys removed
